messages.subject: Spatial data for INLA
parts:
Good morning,

I'm currently facing  an issue in R when trying to use INLA for my data.  I have a lot of highly interconnected spatial structures (roughly 5500). I always get the same output. I have used this for a smaller ammount of spatial structures without any issue, but after 2000 it always displays the same issue (generic error message). I'm not sure if it has to do with the connectivity or size of the mesh, or if it is because of the data.

Error:
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.
Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts,  :
  *** Fail to get good enough initial values. Maybe it is due to something else.
Calls: inla -> inla.core.safe
Execution halted

Thanks.

Julian.

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Spatial data for INLA
parts:
Hi Julian,
As answered in previous messages like this, this is a memory issue and
you try by either using lower "A" in num.threads or having access to
more memory.
Elias
